beats.caption: Mullans, in Irish Na Mulláin. Here is the story of Mullans and its 28 families, from 1901 to 1926.
The censuses of 1901, 1911 and 1926 counted 42, 127 and 109 people in Mullans, in 8, 23 and 18 households. Heads of household included McCloskey, Day and Gallinagh.
Here are the families of Mullans, from 1901 to 1926. First, the Harvey and McCloskey families.
